info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Insurance Claims Claims Adjusters-v5-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Adjuster Retrieval API provides a streamlined method for retrieving information on insurance claims managed by adjusters. This endpoint allows users to access detailed claim data, facilitating efficient tracking and management of claims. Typical consumers of this API include insurance companies, claims departments, and adjusters looking to enhance their operational efficiency. By leveraging this resource, users can gain insights into claims status and history, ensuring timely responses to policyholders.

get.summary: Retrieve the list of claims adjusters.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of claims adjusters associated with the current claims. It provides necessary information about each adjuster including their contact details and status, facilitating easier management and communication.
